text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon had somehow fallen
fast asleep while standing upright.
She might not be feeling well. Worried, I took her to the infirmary...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Oh my? Where am I...?
I see, I see, so you carried me here.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
My, what a blunder, what a blunder. No matter how extraordinary an Umamusume is,
sleep remains an absolute necessity, it seems.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Still, it proves you can maintain paper quality
even when pulling all-nighters. Quite informative.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
My, it seems I overslept.
I must get back to writing.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Why, of course!
Is there something strange about it?
choice_data_list: You're tackling a difficult research paper, aren't you?
You're working on quite a difficult paper, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Why, of course!
Is there something strange about it?
choice_data_list: You're tackling a difficult research paper, aren't you?
You're working on quite a difficult paper, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Powerful? Ah, but of course.
Intellectual stimulation easily surpasses the physical!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm, piqued your curiosity, has it?
Then allow me to teach you the art of enhancing the body through intellect! That is—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
No, no! There's nothing difficult about it.
I'm merely compiling my research findings.
It's just that the volume happens to be astronomical.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Or perhaps you're curious about the contents of my thesis?
Ah, but of course! It could be nothing else!
Then allow me to explain. In short—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...And that is how the story goes.
Oh my, quite a bit of time has passed, hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Shall we continue in my lab?
You'll be able to savor the contents of my paper firsthand.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Fascinating. By rapidly supercharging metabolism,
muscle hypertrophy accelerates exponentiallyâ
I politely declined Agnes Tachyon's invitation and left the area.
